name: acceptance-gate-kit
description: OneNexus engineering quality tools — acceptance gate for AI-generated features.

plugins.name: acceptance-gate
plugins.description: Acceptance gate for AI-generated features: contract, self-generated evals, evidence-backed verification with deterministic hook enforcement.

plugins.name: feature-loop
plugins.description: Feature development loop on top of acceptance-gate: brainstorm → contract+evals (Gate 1) → plan → execute → multi-agent verify workflow → evidence + human signoff (Gate 2). Requires acceptance-gate + superpowers.

plugins.name: diagram-design
plugins.description: Editorial diagram skill (43 types, HTML+inline SVG) + /export-diagram + /import-drawio, vendored with pin from the private skill repo (upstream cathrynlavery/diagram-design, MIT). Skin state lives in the consuming repo, so one install serves every repo and teammate. Installable on its own; pairs with the kit's DIAGRAM-RULE.

plugins.name: dieu-phoi
plugins.description: Orchestrator–workers for parallel feature-loop sessions: a scheduler that holds the S4 / baseline / merge locks, a batch CLI with five /dieu-phoi commands, five hook entries (block S4 without a lock, heartbeat, waiting-for-human ×2, out-of-quota safety net) and a usage-reading mod. Opt-in per repo (--scope project); hooks stay silent when the repo has no running batch.

plugins.name: road-map
plugins.description: Outer loop of the roadmap: reviews a repo's plan and flags which rows should move milestone, wait for a condition, or be rejected — with machine-readable grounds. Command shell; code lives in acceptance-gate core. Opt-in per repo (--scope project).

plugins.name: tri-thuc
plugins.description: Knowledge layer after Karpathy's LLM Wiki: a repo-declared knowledge store (immutable raw + wiki pages) that every loop reads. Command shell; code lives in acceptance-gate core. Opt-in per repo (--scope project).
